name: ENKI Research Source Routing Pack
description: Per-entity-type source routing for the investigation worker. Stops the firehose pattern where every entity gets all sources (running SEC EDGAR on a person yields nothing useful, running FEC candidate-search on an organization is wasted). Each entity type maps to an ordered list of source identifiers — the investigation worker iterates only those when admit_entity triggers _maybe_queue_investigation. Promoted from a hardcoded list in core/workers/node_builder.py per Phase 7b of the research-validation plan, so the routing decision becomes versioned, signed, and lineage-stamped per investigation. NAMESPACE FIX (2026-07-25): namespaces_owned was ['research.routing'], which owned NEITHER definition id (researchpack.source_routing, research.credentials.catalog) — a pre-existing ceremony failure. Corrected to the namespaces actually used.

metadata.author: ENKI System
metadata.change_control: Adding a new source identifier requires a corresponding handler entry in core/investigation/sources.py (or a research-side bridge). Removing a source from a type's routing requires a 24h soak so any in-flight investigations that referenced the old set complete cleanly.
